'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Cuong Nguyen LS Watch Your Step (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Cuong Nguyen]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step (V) / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V)]]
* '''Username:''' OmegaXen
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
